name: Thorn of Light
body:
School transmutation [light]; Level druid 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (one thorn)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The caster holds a thorn in his open palm as it transforms into brilliant energy and streaks out at his target. The caster must make a successful ranged touch attack, doing so deals 1 point of magical piercing damage to one living creature.
